hook: Reno, Nevada, is further west than Los Angeles.

beats.narration: Reno, Nevada, is further west than Los Angeles.
Los Angeles sits at about one hundred eighteen point two degrees west.
Reno is at one hundred nineteen point eight. A full degree and a half further west.
Because California's coast doesn't run north to south. It slants south-east.
Go far enough down the coast, and even San Diego ends up east of Reno.
beats.claim: San Diego is at about 117.16°W, east of Reno.

beats.narration: Six US state capitals are west of Los Angeles. Including Nevada's own, Carson City.
beats.claim: Six state capitals lie west of Los Angeles, including Carson City.

beats.narration: The West Coast isn't always the westmost.

title: Reno is further WEST than Los Angeles
description: Los Angeles sits at about 118.2°W. Reno, Nevada, is at 119.8°W. The coast slants.
